extraction.Name: John Cordier
extraction.Refused/Protested: Did you ask for that patent? No. Did you make any protest about the patent? No.
extraction.Recorded patent: Did you sign a receipt for it? I think I did.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged and then sold it.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered in 1918 by Mr. Kephart, the farmer at Black Pipe. Received $300 when mortgaged and $2600 when sold; payment for the sale was not all made at one time. Wife and four children depend on him for support.
